capture_candidates.task: sitting on high stool and standing

capture_rights.permitted_scope: Research and inclusion in commercial products, subject to the source's current terms.
capture_rights.restriction: Direct resale of raw motion data or converted motion data is forbidden. No bulk crawling. Source acknowledgement should accompany products/evidence.
capture_rights.handling: Only the two named captures and their matching calibrated skeletons are in scope. Preserve original capture provenance separately from authored activity definitions and retargeted products. Do not relicense capture data under the original-code library license.
capture_rights.sensor_limits: Finger/thumb motions were not captured; toe/hand channels can be noisy. These records do not establish exact sole, grip or seat surface contacts.

format_bridge.preferred_candidate: CMU-linked cgspeed MotionBuilder-friendly BVH conversion, matching the pinned addon CMU(MB) profile
format_bridge.rights_interpretation: Conversion publisher states no added restrictions; its older unrestricted summary does not override current CMU no-direct-resale terms.
format_bridge.remaining_gate: Acquire and hash exactly two selected converted files with their publisher README and verify source IDs, frame count, timestamps, units, channel mapping and added T-pose. Do not treat a converted file as native capture.

fallback_candidate.caveat: Documented possible zero-length bones; separate converter qualification is required. Do not build a new bespoke converter.
